summary: Implemented `v2-cycle-04-catalog-scope-uncertainty`. Added a pure catalog-scope classifier with shared `NO_CATALOG_EVIDENCE`, wired it only into `match_one_hybrid_with_rerank` after query normalization/canonicalization, and marked all OpenSpec tasks complete. Routed unsupported requests now return empty `NOT_FOUND` results with no product/candidates/selection; non-routed requests keep the existing hybrid retrieval and rerank path.
tests: python -m pytest -q tests/test_catalog_scope.py tests/test_matcher.py tests/test_serialization.py (24 passed)
mechanism_evidence: Classifier returns NO_CATALOG_EVIDENCE for combined-cue replacement filter element, filtration media, water-treatment system, and service-only water/filter maintenance profiles.
Classifier fails open for generic filter wording, unknown vendor/model wording, an action verb alone, and service text containing concrete valve/fitting requirements.
Hybrid matcher boundary test proves routed requests bypass fake hybrid retrieval and reranking with zero calls.
Non-routed product-bearing service test proves the current canonicalized hybrid retrieval and original-query reranking inputs are preserved.
Serialization test proves routed results expose NO_CATALOG_EVIDENCE through the existing debug reason while the non-debug payload shape remains unchanged.
